name: Crushes & Cryptids
source:
In this lighthearted dating simulator, you are a Wendigo, and your first day of university has you in a nervous wreck. As you adapt to your new environment, you meet a variety of fellow cryptids and creatures. Your choices will determine if you start off the school year with new friends, enemies, or lovers!

[From [url=https://lumi-kha.itch.io/crushes-and-cryptids]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部轻松愉快的恋爱模拟游戏中，你将扮演一只温迪戈，大学开学的第一天就把你紧张得六神无主。在适应新环境的过程中，你将结识形形色色的神秘生物与异族同学。你的每一个选择都将决定你在新学年伊始收获的是新朋友、死对头，还是甜蜜恋人！

[摘自[url=https://lumi-kha.itch.io/crushes-and-cryptids]itch.io[/url]]
